title: Deployment Identity
description: Per-deployment operator identity. Lives at .local/deployments/<slug>/identity.yml. Defines the apex domain, operator, DNS provider, and network anchors. ADR 0440.

platform_domain.description: Apex domain. Lowercase RFC 1123 hostname. The platform's identity anchor.

platform_operator_email.description: Operator contact email. Used for ACME, alerting, mail bridge.

platform_operator_name.description: Human-readable operator name. Appears in Proxmox notifications, mail headers.

platform_config_prefix.description: Short identifier used in internal config filenames. Defaults to first label of platform_domain.

hetzner_dns_zone_name.description: Hetzner DNS zone name. Defaults to platform_domain.

hetzner_dns_zone_id.description: Hetzner DNS zone ID. Read from Hetzner DNS console.

tailscale_tailnet.description: Tailscale tailnet identifier (e.g. taild0123.ts.net). One per deployment for network isolation.

platform_guest_network_cidr.description: Internal LAN CIDR for guest VMs (e.g. 10.10.10.0/24).

platform_topology_host.description: Ansible reference to the proxmox host that holds the topology facts. Usually `{{ groups['proxmox_hosts'][0] }}`.
